data.one_liner: A responsive universal UI framework package for writing platform-independent code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of responsive widgets like UniversalScaffold, UniversalAppBar, UniversalColumn, and UniversalListView that automatically adjust padding and layouts across mobile, web, and desktop. Uses a 12-column grid system inspired by Bootstrap.
use_when: You want a single codebase to target web, mobile, and desktop platforms seamlessly.
You are already using the Masamune framework in your application.
You need a Bootstrap-like 12-column responsive layout system in Flutter.
avoid_when: You want pure, platform-native Cupertino or Material designs without custom layout abstractions.
You are not using the Masamune framework and want an independent UI package.
strengths: Reduces code duplication across web, desktop, and mobile devices.
Familiar Bootstrap-inspired 12-column grid system via Responsive widgets.
Built-in support for iPadOS window controls avoidance.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Masamune framework ecosystem.
Requires learning custom wrapper widgets instead of standard Flutter components.
data.setup_notes: Initialize by passing UniversalMasamuneAdapter to masamuneAdapters in runMasamuneApp along with the masamune package.

alternatives.name: responsive_framework
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an independent package to automatically scale and adapt UIs across different screen sizes without rewriting your standard Scaffold and widgets.

alternatives.name: responsive_builder
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer explicit layout builders for different screen size breakpoints rather than a bootstrap-like grid component library.
